posts.text: Do Mayor Zohran Mamdani‘s city owned grocery stores in New York City require ID for people to shop in them? US congresswoman Nancy Mace says that they do and she has proof of it, but she’s wrong. Evidence shows that the stores offer a loyalty discount card but allow anyone, regardless of income or residency to shop them without any ID

posts.text: The Senate judiciary committee has advanced Todd Blanche’s nomination for US Attorney General to the full Senate, after Senators Thom Tillis and John Cornyn were satisfied with Blanche’s memo rescinding Trump’s anti weaponization fund. posts.text: Real Justice in America is harder to achieve for Black communities.  A 16 year-old Black girl, Juliana Umba Nzita, was found in Charlotte, North Carolina under suspicious circumstances that should have warranted an investigation, but the Charlotte Mecklenburg Police Department closed the investigation without an autopsy in just three days, ruling out any foul play.

posts.text: UNC Health created a bid-shift system that lets nurses compete for certain premium shifts by accepting lower pay. It’s a system that puts downward pressure on wages and pits healthcare workers against one another. This  is the future of nursing and a warning about the direction of healthcare labor.
